description: This file contains unit tests for the sponge zones API endpoints in the backend of the application, primarily testing the GET /api/v1/map/sponge-zones and GET /api/v1/zone-details routes, including cache behavior, filtering, pagination, validation, and edge cases.

classes.name: TestSpongeZonesEndpoint
classes.description: Test suite for the GET /api/v1/map/sponge-zones endpoint, covering successful data retrieval, caching, filtering by capacity, validation, pagination, and boundary cases.

classes.name: TestZoneDetailsEndpoint
classes.description: Test suite for the GET /api/v1/zone-details endpoint, covering retrieval of specific zone data, not found scenarios, parameter validation, and caching.

methods.name: test_get_sponge_zones_returns_geojson( self, mock_get_cache, mock_get_client, client, sample_zone_data, mock_cache )
methods.description: Tests that the sponge zones API endpoint returns a valid GeoJSON FeatureCollection with correct features and metadata.

methods.name: test_get_sponge_zones_uses_cache( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, mock_cache, sample_zone_data )
methods.description: Verifies that the endpoint utilizes caching by checking initial database query and subsequent cache hit.

methods.name: test_get_sponge_zones_filters_by_capacity( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, sample_zone_data, mock_cache )
methods.description: Tests filtering sponge zones by capacity category, ensuring only relevant features are returned.

methods.name: test_get_sponge_zones_validates_capacity_category(self, client)
methods.description: Ensures invalid capacity category query parameters are rejected with a 422 error.

methods.name: test_get_sponge_zones_pagination( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, sample_zone_data, mock_cache )
methods.description: Checks pagination parameters (limit, offset) and response metadata for correct handling.

methods.name: test_get_sponge_zones_validates_pagination_bounds(self, client)
methods.description: Verifies pagination parameters are validated for bounds, such as limit range and non-negative offset.

methods.name: test_get_sponge_zones_handles_empty_result( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, mock_cache )
methods.description: Tests the endpoint's response when no zones are found, ensuring it returns an empty feature collection with appropriate message.

methods.name: test_get_zone_details_returns_single_zone( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, sample_zone_data, mock_cache )
methods.description: Verifies retrieving details for a specific existing zone returns correct data.

methods.name: test_get_zone_details_not_found( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, mock_cache )
methods.description: Checks response when a zone ID does not match any record, expecting a 404 error.

methods.name: test_get_zone_details_validates_zone_id(self, client)
methods.description: Ensures zone_id parameter validation rejects dangerous inputs like SQL injections and XSS attempts.

methods.name: test_get_zone_details_requires_zone_id(self, client)
methods.description: Verifies that the zone_id parameter is required, returning validation error if missing.

methods.name: test_get_zone_details_uses_cache( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, mock_cache, sample_zone_data )
methods.description: Validates caching behavior for zone details endpoint, ensuring cached data is used after initial fetch.
